name: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description:
Merge two sorted linked lists into one sorted list.

The list should be made by splicing together the nodes of the first two lists. Return the head of the merged linked list.
hints: Use a dummy node (`dummy := &ListNode{}`) to simplify edge cases with the head.
Maintain a pointer `tail := dummy`. Compare `list1.Val` and `list2.Val`, point `tail.Next` to the smaller one, and advance that list's pointer.
When one list runs out, attach the non-nil remainder directly (`tail.Next = list1` or `list2`). Return `dummy.Next`.
